description: Synthetic utility and home-internet account fixture for package validation; not an evaluation task.

sources.description: Areas, premises, services, bills, payments and notifications written by the seeded generator, which produces account history by running Homegrid's own handlers. All towns, addresses, people, tariffs and fees are fictional; no record describes a real customer, utility or rate.

transformations: All times are RFC 3339 with UTC offsets; money is integer US cents; usage is in kWh and gallons.

review.notes: Automatic checks do not replace human review of realism, wording and provenance.
